49	def compare(root, evidence):
50	    """Attach the baseline and the delta to a finished measurement run."""
51	    lines = measured(root)
52	    previous = baseline(root)
53	    # A first measurement is not a regression: there is nothing to have fallen from.
54	    delta = None if previous is None else round(lines - float(previous), 4)
55	    return dict(evidence, package=GATED_PACKAGE, lines=lines, baseline=previous, delta=delta)

63	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
